geography_method: Population-weighted Census2020 PUMA-to-county allocation, matched to February2013 CBSA counties and published2024 SPM menu. Unrepresented county mass remains national. Full-MSA and residual membership approximate confidential CPS geography; neither county assignments nor rent medians are official Census reproductions.

source_vintages.2022: 2018–2022 PUMS with restored December2025 PUMA/weight update

sources.derivation_method: Sum Census2020 P.L.94-171 geographic header summary-level140 POP100 by PUMA and county using Census2020 tract-to-PUMA relationship. Validate each state total against summary-level040. Divide each PUMA/county population by its PUMA total. The exact resulting final PUMA-to-area allocation map is committed in area_allocations.

Match Census2020 county codes to February2013 metropolitan CBSA county delineations; recognized published2024 SPM MSA codes use fullMSA approximation, other metropolitan counties use the same-state residualMetro only when published, remaining counties use published same-stateNonmetro. Unrepresented counties retain null area. Join county assignments to population-weighted PUMA/county fractions, aggregate once per PUMA/area and preserve unassigned fractions. The exact resulting final allocation map is committed in area_allocations; suppressed/unsampled CPS state portions remain unresolved.

topcode_method: Cohort-specific published state component thresholds applied to nominal values; flags retained in donor copies. Lower bounds use known cash rent, or cash-rent threshold if censored; upper bound unbounded. This conservative diagnostic does not identify uncensored gross rents.
